triage_note.priority_rationale: [offline template] HIGH severity rule 'code.sql-string-interpolation' fired at app.py:23 with medium confidence; ranked by the deterministic severity x confidence score.
triage_note.fix_guidance: Use parameterized queries / prepared statements; never interpolate values into SQL text.

investigation.summary: No input validation or escaping calls found in the flagged file. This is regex-level evidence, not dataflow: the value may still be constrained upstream. Treat the interpolation as injectable until it is parameterized or a dataflow check proves the input path safe.

findings.title: SQL built with Python % string formatting
findings.description: Applying % formatting to a SQL string interpolates values before the driver sees them, which is SQL injection when any value is user-influenced.
findings.remediation: Pass parameters separately (execute(query, params)) with the driver's placeholder style; never % or .format() values into SQL text.

triage_note.priority_rationale: [offline template] HIGH severity rule 'code.sql-percent-format' fired at app.py:29 with medium confidence; ranked by the deterministic severity x confidence score.
triage_note.fix_guidance: Pass parameters separately (execute(query, params)) with the driver's placeholder style; never % or .format() values into SQL text.

findings.title: Weak hash near password handling
findings.description: MD5/SHA-1 used to hash passwords is trivially crackable at scale.
findings.remediation: Use a password KDF: bcrypt, scrypt, or Argon2id, with a per-user salt.

triage_note.priority_rationale: [offline template] HIGH severity rule 'code.weak-hash-password-context' fired at app.py:34 with medium confidence; ranked by the deterministic severity x confidence score.
triage_note.fix_guidance: Use a password KDF: bcrypt, scrypt, or Argon2id, with a per-user salt.

findings.title: Subprocess with shell=True
findings.description: Running a subprocess through the shell makes command injection likely if any part of the command string is influenced by input.
findings.remediation: Pass arguments as a list with shell=False, and validate or allowlist any input that reaches the command.

triage_note.priority_rationale: [offline template] HIGH severity rule 'code.python-shell-true' fired at app.py:38 with medium confidence; ranked by the deterministic severity x confidence score.
triage_note.fix_guidance: Pass arguments as a list with shell=False, and validate or allowlist any input that reaches the command.

findings.title: Deserialization with pickle
findings.description: Unpickling attacker-controlled data is arbitrary code execution.
findings.remediation: Use JSON or another data-only format for untrusted input; reserve pickle for trusted, integrity-checked local data.

triage_note.priority_rationale: [offline template] HIGH severity rule 'code.python-pickle-load' fired at app.py:42 with medium confidence; ranked by the deterministic severity x confidence score.
triage_note.fix_guidance: Use JSON or another data-only format for untrusted input; reserve pickle for trusted, integrity-checked local data.

findings.title: Use of eval()
findings.description: eval() executes arbitrary Python. If the input is reachable by users it is remote code execution.
findings.remediation: Replace eval() with ast.literal_eval for data, or an explicit parser/dispatch table for behavior.

triage_note.priority_rationale: [offline template] HIGH severity rule 'code.python-eval' fired at app.py:46 with medium confidence; ranked by the deterministic severity x confidence score.
triage_note.fix_guidance: Replace eval() with ast.literal_eval for data, or an explicit parser/dispatch table for behavior.

findings.title: innerHTML assignment
findings.description: Assigning to innerHTML with data that includes user input is a DOM XSS sink.
findings.remediation: Use textContent for plain text, or sanitize with a vetted library (e.g. DOMPurify) before writing HTML.

triage_note.priority_rationale: [offline template] MEDIUM severity rule 'code.js-innerhtml' fired at app.js:5 with medium confidence; ranked by the deterministic severity x confidence score.
triage_note.fix_guidance: Use textContent for plain text, or sanitize with a vetted library (e.g. DOMPurify) before writing HTML.
